evidence: We observe a regular increase of a and corresponding decrease of c on increasing TS. Both lattice parameters ( c and a) approach the value of lattice parameters of the bulk ZnO crystal with the increase of growth temperature. Simultaneously, the c/a axial ratio decreases monotonically (Fig. 3). It is interesting to note that all these changes do not affect the unit cell volume (calculated from lattice parameters), which remains almost constant, at least within the experimental error limit ( Fig. 4 a). Such situation indicates that growth conditions are not far from epitaxial, with a strain in a film gradually decreasing with a film thickness.
